liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain And Snow** (1 review): Donna's vocals are exceptionally strong, carrying the performance in a way rarely seen [10]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): This jam is considered one of the best, qualifying the show for a top twenty slot [10]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The reviewer finds this specific jam sequence to be a stunning highlight of the show [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-12-27.137166.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 186 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd77-12-27.sbd.cotsman.19288.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 160 min; rated 4.43/5 by 35 [2]. Said about its sound: The band plays with high energy from the first note, keeping the listener engaged; The first set is high octane with full swing drums, while the second set closes loosely; The performance features incredible consistent energy, with no moment wasted throughout the entire show [5][9][15]
- **gd1977-12-27.sbd.ashley-bertha.24069.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 152 min; rated 3.55/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: An encore from another source was excluded due to poor sound quality [3]
- **gd1977-12-27.sbd.redbeard.2989.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 152 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- All four nights of this run are strong, with the 29th being legendary [6]
- This is the reviewer's least favorite of the three 1977 Winterland runs, lacking the extra special ingredient [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-12-27.137166.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat (44.1k) [1]. Also: The tape includes part of the set break, which the uploader chose to keep [1]
- **gd77-12-27.sbd.cotsman.19288.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1977-12-27.sbd.ashley-bertha.24069.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Bertha Remaster of the Master Reel source by Jay Ashley; source: SBD>>MR>>SS>>DAT>>CDA>>WAV(EAC)>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA/SHN [3]. Also: Digitally remastered in 2004 using a custom Dual-DAW nicknamed Bertha by an archive user [3]
- **gd1977-12-27.sbd.redbeard.2989.shnf**: transferred by David Gans and Redbeard; source: MSR>>DAT>Sonic Solutions remastering>CDR [4]
